description: claude auth login run on the host (a chat's claude signed in again there): one a connection, its answers login_said as it says each line, then login_end; the connection's going stops it. session: the chat it's for, whose sign-in (ChatLogin) its host moves as it goes and tells every head attached to it (login_state).

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

session.description: The chat it signs in for, if any: ignored (the sign-in runs, for no chat) if the asker may not read it (Agent Management's read).
